newsitem.title: CHINA: China police chief urges battle against drugs.
newsitem.headline: China police chief urges battle against drugs.

text.p: Chinese Minister of Public Security Tao Siju has urged the international community to take more effective steps to combat drug crimes worldwide, Xinhua news agency reported on Tuesday.
Tao, speaking at a five-day international anti-drug conference that opened in Shanghai on Monday, said China would make every effort to assist in the international crackdown on drug-related crime.
The meeting, sponsored by the United Nations International Drug Control Program (IDCP), is focusing on how to deal with the global abuse of steroids and stimulants.
Shanghai was the site of the world's first international anti-drug conference held in 1909 to ban the trafficking and use of opium.
